query: SELECT workspace_user.user_id AS "user_id: Uuid", role_binding.role_id AS "role_id: Uuid", role_binding.scope_id AS "scope_id: Uuid" FROM role_binding INNER JOIN workspace_user ON role_binding.actor_id = workspace_user.actor_id WHERE workspace_user.workspace_id = $1 AND workspace_user.user_id = ANY($2::UUID[]);
